title: Daybreak
description: A free 3D battle royale on a shrinking island. Twelve contestants smash crates for weapons, chain hits into heavy finishers and dodge-roll out of danger. A supply drop lands at every daybreak and the tide rises every night. Last one standing wins. Play online or solo against bots, in your browser on phone or desktop.
how_to_play: WASD to move, mouse or drag to look, click or J to attack, Space to jump, Shift or right-click to dodge-roll, Q to switch weapons, Tab for the scoreboard. Walk over loot to take it and over food to heal. Land three hits in a row for a heavy finisher, and keep to high ground at night because the sea drains your health. Touch: left thumb moves, drag on the right to look, the big button attacks.
